svg.title: Binomial measures on the same set with t equal to 1, 3/7 and 1/9

g.text: The weight dial is mult-add's per-element t: same set, same dimension, mass shared unevenly
all Rényi dimensions D_q equal ½
Bars: mass on each level-5 piece of set A, scaled to the tallest. The support never changes, so dimension stays ½.
Only the split p : 1−p moves, which is exactly the odds t = p/(1−p) (Lean: weights_odds).
